notes_translated.en: Data collated from the UNDP Human Development reports on working poor and multidimensional poverty indicators for each Lower Mekong country. Collated for an interactive visualization on the OD Mekong Social development page (https://opendevelopmentmekong.net/topics/social-development/).

CI_ResponsibleParty_contact.en: ODI researcher: David Hill UNDP: Anna Ortubia, HDRO Communications Officer, (anna.ortubia@undp.org), +1-212-906-5964

MD_ScopeDescription_attributes.en: Excel spreadsheet with two tabs, one containing data and one with notes and sources.

LI_Lineage.en: UNDP. Human Development Reports, 2015. http://report.hdr.undp.org/ Full data download: http://hdr.undp.org/sites/default/files/2015_statistical_annex_tables_all.xls

LI_ProcessStep.en: Downloaded the spreadsheet containing the full data of the Human Development Report, 2015 (http://hdr.undp.org/sites/default/files/2015_statistical_annex_tables_all.xls). Copied two indicators ("Population in severe multidimensional poverty", "Working poor at PPP $2 a day") for each Lower Mekong country (Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam) from "Table 1A: Work with exploitation, risks and insecurities", and "Table 6: Multidimensional Poverty Index: developing countries" into a new Excel spreadsheet and save.

MD_Constraints.en: "All materials provided on this website are copyrighted under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 IGO license." http://hdr.undp.org/en/content/copyright-and-terms-use

DQ_Completeness.en: Data for Myanmar not available from this source for percentage of population in multidimensional poverty.

DQ_LogicalConsistency.en: Note that the data contained in this 2015 report is for various years depending on original sources used by the UNDP. Multidimensional poverty data refer to the most recent year available between 2005-2012. Working poor data are for the most recent year available between 2003-2012.
